debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d s-i-g-n-a-l o-b-f-u-s-c-a-t-i-o-n f-o-r d-r-o-n-e n-a-v i-g-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t t-h-e c-o-n-f-i-g f-i-l-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d l-o-g r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-t-e-r-e-d i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y t-h-r-o-u-g-h r-o-u-t-e-s, l-e-f-t m-e-t-a d-a-t-a, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e p-u-r-g-i-n-g.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-v-e-r-r-o-d-e t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-i-m-e l-i-n-e-s o-f i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e, l-e-f-t t-h-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e a-n-o-m-a-l-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-a-b-l-e-d a-l-a-r-m n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n f-o-r r-o-u-t-e d-e-v-i-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t t-h-e d-i-s-a-b-l-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d r-e-a-l t-i-m-e m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-g-n-o-r-e-d w-a-r-n-i-n-g m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s d-u-r-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e, l-e-f-t t-h-e a-l-a-r-m-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e p-o-s-t e-v-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t.
